audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows were wrong. win[2] said Darius while whys[2] says 'Skill'; win[3] said Skill while whys[3] says a landed pull can outright kill you; win[5] said Skill while whys[5] says Yone-favoured; win[6] said Darius while whys[6] says Yone-favoured. The darius__yone mirror already flipped Levels 4-5 to Darius and 2+ items to Yone, and the packet chart matches every one of these.
audit.why: The chart, the reasons under it, the packet and the mirror all agreed with each other and disagreed with the rendered rows.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Darius / Darius / Skill / Darius / Darius / Yone / Yone across both layers. phases[3].rating 5/10 to 3/10 and phases[6].rating 2/10 to 6/10, as the inverses of the mirror's 7/10 and 4/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend is the tracked ability on every screen and its cooldown appears nowhere.
audit.why: 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s is the longest cooldown in his kit by a distance — it is the single number that tells you when you are allowed to stand near him. His R is 120/100/80 and refreshes on a kill.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[3].why and spikes[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] calls the pull 'his W-Apprehend (E)', blending two abilities, and then says 'never dash E toward him' — Soul Unbound is not a dash and has no direction. wants.you[0] tells you to 'melt his Apprehend pull with your own E dash', which is not something Soul Unbound does. spikes[3] claims late mobility makes you 'nearly impossible to pull'; Apprehend is a 535-range hook that still lands.
audit.why: The real answer to Apprehend is range discipline and its 26-second cooldown, not a Yone ability that cannot counter it. Also missing entirely: Crippling Strike is an auto-attack reset on a 5s cooldown, so his wind-up is the tell, and Noxian Guillotine is true damage, so stacking armour does nothing against the thing that actually kills you.
audit.corrected: Names untangled, the false counter removed, the 535 range and 26s cooldown given as the real answer, and the auto-reset tell plus true-damage warning added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Decimate heals him off the blade and the content layer never mentions Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Extended trades refund his health off every outer-edge hit.
audit.corrected: Added to breakdown.cooldowns alongside the blade-versus-handle distinction.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Darius must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online. Dodging Apprehend decides the trade, so hold the wave near your side and space every walk-up.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Apprehend's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: A landed pull into Q and Guillotine kills you here. Apprehend is 26s at rank 1, and that gap is your only safe window.

edits.before: Darius owns this window: his Q outer-edge heals him and his W-Apprehend (E) pull yanks you into a full bleed-stack Noxian Guillotine setup, so never dash E toward him for CS.
edits.after: Darius owns this window: Decimate's outer edge heals him off you, and Apprehend (E, 26s at rank 1) yanks you into a full bleed-stack Guillotine. Never walk into that range for a CS.

edits.before: Yone takes over — your mobility and R make you nearly impossible to pull and stack, and you out-DPS him in extended fights.
edits.after: Yone takes over: Soul Unbound is down to 10s, so you can commit and rewind out of every fight, and you out-DPS his cooldowns.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay red — a single E pull into Q-autos-R can outright kill you, so farm at max range, dodge his pull with your E, and never greed CS under his cooldowns.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay red — one pull into Q and Guillotine can kill you outright. Crippling Strike is an auto reset, so his wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.

edits.before: Melt his Apprehend (E) pull with your own E dash so you're never yanked in
edits.after: Hold outside Apprehend's 535 range so you are never the one yanked in

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Stay out of range. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Apprehend: 26s at rank 1 — the longest gap in his kit and your only real window. - Decimate: the blade heals him, the handle does not, so fight close and bring Grievous Wounds. - Noxian Guillotine: true damage, armour is no answer.

edits.before: His all-in start. Stay out of range. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 535 range, 26s at rank 1 — step outside it and his all-in cannot start.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: At five Hemorrhage stacks he enrages and Guillotine turns lethal.

edits.before: E-ing in while his answer is up or overstaying the soul timer — the snap-back position is where Yones die.
edits.after: The blade heals him and the handle does not, so stand in close rather than out at the edge of his axe.

notes: wants.you[1] ('fight only at the center of his Q so it heals him minimally') is CORRECT and I left it alone — Riot's text confirms the blade does more damage and provides the heal while the handle does neither, so standing inside the swing is right. The chart now matches the packet, the mirror and its own whys in all seven rows. I did adjust two ratings as inverses of the mirror's numbers (its 7/10 for Levels 4-5 and 4/10 for 2+ items); if this page's ratings are not meant to be inverted, those two edits should be dropped.
